title: Vesper and the Wolf
author: Odile Crane
blurb: Silas Fairweather, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
